title: Puppy and kitten
simplified_paragraphs: 我的小狗第一次看见朋友的小猫，很害怕。
小狗第二次看见小猫时，它站在小猫旁边，看着小猫。
第三次看见小猫时，它走过去，和小猫玩。
traditional_paragraphs: 我的小狗第一次看見朋友的小貓，很害怕。
小狗第二次看見小貓時，它站在小貓旁邊，看著小貓。
第三次看見小貓時，它走過去，和小貓玩。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ de xiǎo gǒu dì yī cì kàn jiàn péng you de xiǎo māo， hěn hài pà。
xiǎo gǒu dì èr cì kàn jiàn xiǎo māo shí， tā zhàn zài xiǎo māo páng biān， kàn zhe xiǎo māo。
dì sān cì kàn jiàn xiǎo māo shí， tā zǒu guò qù， hé xiǎo māo wán。
hěn kuài， tā men chéng le hǎo péng you。
english_paragraphs: The first time my puppy saw my friend's kitten, it was very scared.
The second time the puppy saw the kitten, it stood beside the kitten and watched it.
The third time it saw the kitten, it went over and played with it.
english_full:
The first time my puppy saw my friend's kitten, it was very scared.

The second time the puppy saw the kitten, it stood beside the kitten and watched it.

The third time it saw the kitten, it went over and played with it.

Soon, they became good friends.
